# mergegateway_dlp_rule (Resource)

Manages a custom data loss prevention (DLP) rule: a pattern or keywords the Gateway looks for in requests, and what it does when one matches. The built-in (seeded) rules can't be created or deleted, so this resource doesn't manage them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Redact employee IDs such as EMP-123456 from requests.
resource "mergegateway_dlp_rule" "employee_id" {
  entity_type = "EMPLOYEE_ID"
  description = "Internal employee IDs"
  pattern     = "EMP-\\d{6}"
  action      = "redact"
}

# Block requests that mention internal project code names.
resource "mergegateway_dlp_rule" "code_names" {
  entity_type = "PROJECT_CODE_NAME"
  keywords    = ["bluebird", "nightjar"]
  action      = "block"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_type` (String) The rule's name, unique among the organization's custom rules.

### Optional

- `action` (String) What to do when the rule matches: `log`, `redact` or `block`. Defaults to `log`.
- `description` (String) A description of the rule. Defaults to none (`""`).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is on. Defaults to `true`.
- `keywords` (List of String) Words the rule matches, at most 50, each up to 100 characters, kept in the order given. Set `pattern`, `keywords` or both.
- `pattern` (String) A regular expression (Python syntax) the rule matches. Set `pattern`, `keywords` or both.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the rule was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The rule's ID.
- `updated_at` (String) When the rule was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a custom DLP rule by its ID. Seeded rules can't be imported.
terraform import mergegateway_dlp_rule.employee_id 3a4b5c6d-7e8f-4a0b-9c1d-2e3f4a5b6c7d
```
